llmlang.flow.generate_flow.disposition: a called entry's own trailing return bullet ("returns ..." or an explicit ← return) now renders at the calling → call line's own depth instead of nested one level inside the called entry's body - matches flow-format.md's original stated rule that a return sits at the same indentation as its matching call, marking control coming back out to the caller's level rather than still being 'inside' the callee.

llmlang.flow.generate_flow_for_tree.disposition: also excludes a top-level 'should ...' bullet from flow content, the same as a ~ test bullet - some entries (llmlang.lockfile_checker.check among them) describe guarantees using that phrasing as plain - bullets rather than literal ~ bullets, and they read exactly like test assertions cluttering an execution trace, so they're excluded from generated flow views the same way.
